segments.an7.51:1.2: Taṃ suṇātha … pe … katamo ca so, bhikkhave, saṃyogo visaṃyogo dhammapariyāyo?
segments.an7.51:2.1: “Itthī, bhikkhave, ajjhattaṃ itthindriyaṃ manasi karoti – itthikuttaṃ itthākappaṃ itthividhaṃ itthicchandaṃ itthissaraṃ itthālaṅkāraṃ.
segments.an7.51:2.4: Sā tattha rattā tatrābhiratā bahiddhā purisindriyaṃ manasi karoti – purisakuttaṃ purisākappaṃ purisavidhaṃ purisacchandaṃ purisassaraṃ purisālaṅkāraṃ.
segments.an7.51:2.7: Sā tattha rattā tatrābhiratā bahiddhā saṃyogaṃ ākaṅkhati.
segments.an7.51:2.8: Yañcassā saṃyogapaccayā uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ tañca ākaṅkhati.
segments.an7.51:2.9: Itthatte, bhikkhave, abhiratā sattā purisesu saṃyogaṃ gatā.
segments.an7.51:2.10: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, itthī itthattaṃ nātivattati.
segments.an7.51:3.1: “Puriso, bhikkhave, ajjhattaṃ purisindriyaṃ manasi karoti – purisakuttaṃ purisākappaṃ purisavidhaṃ purisacchandaṃ purisassaraṃ purisālaṅkāraṃ.
segments.an7.51:3.4: So tattha ratto tatrābhirato bahiddhā itthindriyaṃ manasi karoti – itthikuttaṃ itthākappaṃ itthividhaṃ itthicchandaṃ itthissaraṃ itthālaṅkāraṃ.
segments.an7.51:3.7: So tattha ratto tatrābhirato bahiddhā saṃyogaṃ ākaṅkhati.
segments.an7.51:3.8: Yañcassa saṃyogapaccayā uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ tañca ākaṅkhati.
segments.an7.51:3.9: Purisatte, bhikkhave, abhiratā sattā itthīsu saṃyogaṃ gatā.
segments.an7.51:3.10: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, puriso purisattaṃ nātivattati.
segments.an7.51:4.2: Itthī, bhikkhave, ajjhattaṃ itthindriyaṃ na manasi karoti – itthikuttaṃ itthākappaṃ itthividhaṃ itthicchandaṃ itthissaraṃ itthālaṅkāraṃ.
segments.an7.51:4.4: Sā tattha na rajjati, sā tatra nābhiramati.
segments.an7.51:4.5: Sā tattha arattā tatra anabhiratā bahiddhā purisindriyaṃ na manasi karoti – purisakuttaṃ purisākappaṃ purisavidhaṃ purisacchandaṃ purisassaraṃ purisālaṅkāraṃ.
segments.an7.51:4.7: Sā tattha na rajjati, tatra nābhiramati.
segments.an7.51:4.8: Sā tattha arattā tatra anabhiratā bahiddhā saṃyogaṃ nākaṅkhati.
segments.an7.51:4.9: Yañcassā saṃyogapaccayā uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ tañca nākaṅkhati.
segments.an7.51:4.10: Itthatte, bhikkhave, anabhiratā sattā purisesu visaṃyogaṃ gatā.
segments.an7.51:4.11: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, itthī itthattaṃ ativattati.
segments.an7.51:5.1: “Puriso, bhikkhave, ajjhattaṃ purisindriyaṃ na manasi karoti – purisakuttaṃ purisākappaṃ purisavidhaṃ purisacchandaṃ purisassaraṃ purisālaṅkāraṃ.
segments.an7.51:5.3: So tattha na rajjati, so tatra nābhiramati.
segments.an7.51:5.4: So tattha aratto tatra anabhirato bahiddhā itthindriyaṃ na manasi karoti – itthikuttaṃ itthākappaṃ itthividhaṃ itthicchandaṃ itthissaraṃ itthālaṅkāraṃ.
segments.an7.51:5.6: So tattha na rajjati, tatra nābhiramati.
segments.an7.51:5.7: So tattha aratto tatra anabhirato bahiddhā saṃyogaṃ nākaṅkhati.
segments.an7.51:5.8: Yañcassa saṃyogapaccayā uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ tañca nākaṅkhati.
segments.an7.51:5.9: Purisatte, bhikkhave, anabhiratā sattā itthīsu visaṃyogaṃ gatā.
segments.an7.51:5.10: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, puriso purisattaṃ ativattati.
segments.an7.51:5.12: Ayaṃ kho, bhikkhave, saṃyogo visaṃyogo dhammapariyāyo”ti.

lines: Ativattatīti anabhiratāti evaṃ vuttāya balavavipassanāya ariyamaggaṃ patvā ativattati.
Samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vāti pabbajjāmattena samaṇo vā, jātimattena brāhmaṇo vā.
Idampi khoti ettha idanti yathāvuttaṃ sādiyanādiṃ khaṇḍādibhāvavasena ekaṃ katvā vuttaṃ.
Idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti – yadetaṃ brahmacāripaṭiññassa asatipi dvayaṃdvayasamāpattiyaṃ mātugāmassa ucchādananahāpanasambāhanasādiyanādi.
Idampi ekaṃsena tassa brahmacariyassa khaṇḍādibhāvāpādanato khaṇḍampi chiddampi sabalampi kammāsampīti.
Evaṃ pana khaṇḍādibhāvāpattiyā so aparisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carati, na parisuddhaṃ, saṃyutto methunasaṃyogena, na visaṃyutto.
Tato cassa na jātiādīhi parimuttīti dassento “ayaṃ vuccatī”tiādimāha.
Yā kāci vā bhitti porisakā diyaḍḍharatanappamāṇā kuṭṭaṃ, tato adhiko pākāro.
